description.narrative: The Project Development Objectives are to: (a) increase efficiency of road transport along the Northern Corridor to facilitate trade and regional intergration; (b) enhance aviation safety and security to meet international standards; and (c) promote private sector participation in the management, financing and maintenance of road assets; and (iv) restore vital infrastructure and public assets damaged as a result of the 2007 post-election crisis.

The Project seeks to increase efficiency of road transport along the Northern Corridor, to facilitate trade, and regional integration, enhance aviation safety, and security to meet international standards; and, promote private sector participation in the management, financing, and maintenance of road assets. The project consists of eight components as follows. The Rehabilitation of the Northern Road Corridor component will strengthen and rehabilitate priority road sections along the Northern Corridor, to withstand traffic projections, and, provide reliable road transport services. Additionally, improvements at the Airport North Road will be implemented. The component will also provide consultant services for supervision of works. The Socioeconomic Enhancement, Roadside Amenities and HIV/AIDS Mitigation component involves the construction of bus stops/terminals at key selected locations, to include parking areas, and utilities infrastructure. Bicycle paths, and pedestrian sidewalks will also be included, as well as other roadside features to enhance safety. In particular, HIV/AIDS mitigation aims at ,in collaboration with the National HIVlAIDS program, the International Transport Federation, and the Truckers Association, providing specific interventions along the Northern Corridor, to support and care for affected persons. The Private Sector Participation in Road Management and Maintenance component, will promote public-private partnerships in the road sector, through technical assistance to facilitate concessioning of selected sections of the Northern Corridor road link, and, a pilot program for long-term performance-based maintenance, and management of a selected sub-network of minor roads. The Road Safety Improvement component seeks to reduce accidents, through implementation and monitoring of a road safety program - i.e., road safety education, and public awareness campaigns, capacity building, and emergency services, and road safety regulations and enforcement. Other components address Institutional Strengthening in the Roads Sector, and Technical Assistance to support capacity building and strengthening of the road sector institutional and policy reforms, including strengthening research and development, and conducting feasibility, engineering and design studies on the Mombasa bypass; Support to the Kenya Airports Authority through civil works, consultant services, equipment supply, and information technology to improve operations, search and rescue capacity, and the safety and security standards at the various airports; Support to the Kenya Civil Aviation Authority (KCAA), for safety inspection, training, reform implementation, equipment and implementation of Global Navigation Satellite Systems, Global Positioning Systems, in addition to general aviation training; and, Support to the Ministry of Transport and Communications through TA and training, particularly related to maritime laws and regulations.
